title: Bihar CET B.Ed 2026 Answer Key Out Now: Download @ biharcetbed
intro: Babasahab Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Muzaffaprur (BRABU) has Officially Released Answer Key for for B. Ed. Common Entrance Test (CET-BED)-2026 For Regular, Distance and Shiksha Shastri 02 Years Course 2026 (Session: 2026-28). Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Bihar 02 Years B.Ed Admission. Exam Held On June 7, 2026 & Answer Key Released On June 8, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Answer Key Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Last Date For Fee Payment: 18 May 2026
